summary.headline: Valens on Planetary Conjunctions
summary.text: Editorial introduction to Vettius Valens’s discussion of planetary conjunctions, comparing the Neapolitan, Venetian, and Vatican codices and crediting Franz Cumont with supplying the excerpt. The astrological text then describes the effects of Saturn’s conjunctions with Jupiter, Mars, and Mercury on nativities, fortune, enmity, property, learning, and danger.
